components.name: Application controller
components.description: Compares desired Git state with live cluster state

components.name: Diff + sync policy
components.description: Manual / automated sync, prune and self-heal policy

operational_steps: Argo CD fetches and renders revision
Controller compares desired and live state
Sync applies resources to Kubernetes API
Drift triggers sync / self-heal according to policy
failure_checkpoint: Git desired state differs from live state or sync is blocked
recovery_path: Inspect Argo CD diff, repo rendering, sync errors and RBAC; fix Git source or policy deliberately.
